title: Khaak Par Lashae shabbir Hai Aao Nana
body:
Khaak Par Lashae shabbir Hai Aao Nana
kya Yehi Ajr-e-risalath Hai Batao Nana
1. Bhai Be Ghusl-0-kafan Dasht-e-bala Me Hai Pada
paas Mayyath Ke Udhane Ko Nahi Koi Rida
ab Koi Raah Nawasi Ko Dikhao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zulm Beemaar Pa Dhaane Ke Liye Aaye Hai
ashqiya Tauq Pinhane Ke Liye Aaye Hai
ghash Ke Aalam Me Hai Sajjad Bachao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Koi Hamdard Nahi Koi Sahara Bhi Nahi
dashte Zulmath Me Koi Poochne Wala Bhi Nahi
ab Ghareeboun Pe Taras Aap Hi Khao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Thak Ke Soye Hain Badi Der Me Pyase Bache
dashte Tareek Me Ab Koun Hai Jo Pehra De
mere Ghazi Mere Abbas Ko Lao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aap Ke Laal Pa Tooti Hai Qayamath Dekho
qatl Ke Baad Bhi Ummat Ki Adawat Dekho
laash Pamaali Ki Zad Par Hai Bachao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Baap Ko Ro Nahi Sakti Hai Sakina Apne
sehmi Sehmi Si Hai Masoom Tamache Khaake
shimr Ke Zulm Se Bachi Ko Chudao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sar Pe Kunbe Ki Hifazat Ka Hai Zimma Pehle
saamna Shaam-e-ghareeba'n Ka Karungi Kaise
hausla Do Meri Himmat Ko Badao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hashr Rone Ki Sada Se Hai Andhere Bun Me
seena-e-shah Se Lipti Hai Sakina Run Me
baap Ki Laash Se Beti Ko Chudao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Baandhne Aaye Hai Zaalim Mere Baazu Me Rasan
kab Se Awaaz Lagati Hai Musibat Me Behen
bhai Soya Lab-e-darya Hai Jagaao Nana
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Bain Sadiq Ye Behen Ke The Larazti Thi Zamee'n
rone Wala Mere Bhai Pa Yahan Koi Nahi
aao Ab Farsh-e-aza Aake Bichao Nana.
